aggregate.interpretation: Small purpose-built paired set, one outcome per route and question. Exact McNemar is descriptive; Wilson intervals are not paired-effect intervals. No universal accuracy or causal superiority claim.

limitations: Synthetic internally authored questions; no production accuracy guarantee.
Direct service evaluation, not Express admission or browser/hosting validation.
Current standard-rate estimates plus unknown reservations, not an invoice or account balance.
Primary automatic labels include the preserved grader defects described separately in semantic-review.json.
Latency includes service execution, not just provider HTTP time; different paths and this small sample do not establish a speed advantage.
